newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Two banks were Colombia's hottest stocks in '96.
newsitem.headline: Two banks were Colombia's hottest stocks in '96.

text.p: Colombia's two biggest banks, Banco Ganadero and Banco de Colombia, were the country's most actively traded stocks in 1996, the Securities Superintendency said.
Of the two, Banco de Colombia was slightly more active than Ganadero, which ranks as Colombia's largest commercial bank, the agency said.

Brewer Bavaria SA of the Julio Maria Santo Domingo industrial was the third hottest stock followed by cement maker Cementos Argos SA of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno industrial group, the superintendency said.
It said Cadenalco SA, Colombia's largest retailer, was the fifth most actively traded share last year while Banco de Bogota SA ranked as sixth.
In all, 41 stocks on the exchanges in Bogota, Medellin and Cali were listed as "most active." The 41 accounted for about 75 percent of all trading last year.

The list is important for Colombian investors since most actively traded stocks are exempt from a new capital gains tax the government declared in January as one of a series of measures aimed at cutting its fiscal deficit.
